schema.description: Every delivered webhook is one of these two variants. A trigger with a cron schedule carries no document and so cannot be delivered over a webhook.

trigger_id.description: ID of the Platform trigger that produced the event.

doc_id.description: Identifier of the document the event is about.

view_url.description: Link to the document in its source system.

title.description: Title of the document, or the subject for email.

event_time.description: Relevant event time. Document changes use the source-observed time when available and otherwise the document ingestion time; content schedules use the scheduled time. Omitted when no timestamp is available.

content.description: Email body content when the event is for an email document.

content_truncated.description: Present and true when source content exceeded the delivery size limit.
